jobs.title: Armed Patrol Driver – Retail Security & Service
jobs.description:
Allied Universalis recruiting for a Security Officer Armed Patrol Driver in San Antonio, TX. The role involves serving retail clients, patrolling areas, and delivering customer service while monitoring for security risks.

The position requires 21+ and 3+ years of combined security or 5+ years armed experience, plus a valid driver’s license and Texas Level III certification. Training and benefits accompany this full-time posting.
